item.title: By: lisakarentaylor
item.dc:creator: lisakarentaylor
item.description:
Fantastic! I'm imagining the fun it was to brainstorm this.
I have suggestions:
The key phrase for me is "out of it". None of the 101 practices do the work of facing, embracing our shit.
But in my experience some of these can support the work of cooking and processing shit, or can clear my obstacles to doing that work, or can dispel my urge to outsource it.
So I'm not seeing these as either / or. And I'd like to offer a spacious portal into doing work and staying with the work.
My other thought, unless 'shit' includes shadow, is No shit, no shadow, no work
